function: Learned link: IMD-Net modulation/demodulation, CFP-Net CSI feedback and prediction, GEM-Net joint channel estimation and detection (unfolded GEM) under non-Gaussian noise; main metric BER (p. 5, 6, 9).
system: Point-to-point downlink MIMO, Nt=4 transmit and Nr=2 receive antennas (ULA), 3.5 GHz, 512 subcarriers at 30 kHz, receiver at 55 km/h; no RIS (p. 3, 9).
method: Neural networks: FC-layer IMD-Net, encoder-transformer CFP-Net, deep-unfolded GEM-Net with STPG detector; supervised: MSE for CFP-Net first, then joint BCE training of IMD-Net and GEM-Net (p. 6, 7, 8).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa channels following 3GPP TR 38.901: RMa LOS/NLOS training (40 x F x T samples), RMa/UMa/UMi testing; non-Gaussian noise (80% Gaussian, 20% uniform); no measured data (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained on RMa LOS/NLOS, 2x4 antennas, SNR 0-30 dB; tested also on unseen UMa/UMi, Laplace-uniform noise, 2x8 antennas (GEM-Net reused); other modulation orders retrained (p. 9, 10, 11).
baselines: Linear chain (QAM, LS, AR, uncompressed feedback, ZF, LMMSE; also with perfect CSI), independent DL chain (ChannelNet, CsiNet, LSTM predictor, TPG detector), E2E autoencoder [39] (p. 10).
metrics: BER (main), NMSE of the predicted channel (Table IV), trainable parameters, Flops, asymptotic complexity (p. 9, 12, 13).
complexity: IAI 0.94M trainable parameters and asymptotic complexity in Table III (2x4 channels); CFP-Net 8.58M Flops at compression 1/4 (Table IV) (p. 12, 13).
q1_support: p. 9: "Quadriga [53] is employed to generate channels conforming to 3GPP TR 38.901 specifications [42]".
q2_support: p. 10: "we compare the IAI algorithms with comparative methods in the UMa-LOS and UMi-NLOS scenarios using trained models in the RMa scenario"; p. 11: GEM-Net reuses models trained on 2 x 4 channels for Nt = 8.
q3_support: p. 10: "the traditional linear method, independent DL-based method, and the E2E-based method [39]" are the comparison methods; "our proposed IAI algorithms outperform significantly other methods at all SNRs" in BER (Fig. 4).
q4_support: p. 12: "evaluating trainable parameters and asymptotic complexity" (Table III: IAI 0.94M parameters); p. 13: "the number of trainable parameters and floating-point operations (Flops) to evaluate the complexity" (Table IV).
q5_support: p. 9: "Quadriga [53] is employed to generate channels conforming to 3GPP TR 38.901 specifications [42]": channels are self-generated with a simulator; no code or data link, public dataset or measurement is mentioned anywhere.
notes: The PDF is the paper of the DOI (p. 1: Digital Object Identifier 10.1109/TWC.2025.3620862). Multi-function method: IMD-Net modulation is outside the seven areas, CFP-Net is area 2, GEM-Net is areas 1 and 2; area 1 chosen because the main metric is BER (p. 9: "We use BER as the performance metric"). Reviewer to confirm. q5 is 0 because QuaDRiGa output is self-generated, not a released or public dataset. Tables II to IV read from page images (p. 9, 12, 13).
